name: Model Context Protocol and agent-to-agent integration
label: Model Context Protocol and agent-to-agent integration
summary: Connects agents to knowledge sources and to each other through shared, standard protocols rather than one-off connections.

name: Concept laddering
label: Concept laddering
summary: Moves up by asking why something matters and down by asking how it is done, to reach goals and sub-steps.

name: Critical incident technique
label: Critical incident technique
summary: Collects specific occasions when a process succeeded, failed or needed improvisation to surface judgment calls.
elicitation_tradeoff: Gives up accuracy for practicality: rare events are recalled and reconstructed rather than witnessed.

name: Document analysis
label: Document analysis
summary: Extracts candidate knowledge from SOPs, training material, decision matrices and system documentation.

name: Enterprise architecture practice
label: Enterprise architecture practice
summary: Enterprise architecture's repository discipline, applied to process knowledge: business processes, the roles that perform them, the functions and tools that support them and the information they consume are modelled as separate governed entities in one repository, and a change to any of them is reviewed for its effect on the others.
elicitation_tradeoff: Gives a whole-organization view and a governed change path, at the cost of a heavier repository than a single procedure's authors need.

name: Faceted classification
label: Faceted classification
summary: Classifies each item along several independent facets instead of one hierarchy.

name: Facilitated workshop
label: Facilitated workshop
summary: A session bringing together people who initiate, execute and receive a process to map it together.
elicitation_tradeoff: Gives up depth for reach: many roles at once, each heard briefly.

name: Graph-grounded retrieval-augmented generation
label: Graph-grounded retrieval-augmented generation
summary: Retrieves structured segments from the knowledge graph to ground an AI answer.

name: Controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, then ontologies
label: Controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, then ontologies
summary: Establishes controlled vocabularies and a taxonomy first, then aligns them to a formal ontology.

name: Linked Open Terms methodology
label: Linked Open Terms methodology
summary: Lightweight, reuse-based ontology engineering: requirements, implementation, publication, maintenance.

name: Evaluations and benchmarks for language-model systems
label: Evaluations and benchmarks for language-model systems
summary: Measures an AI system's accuracy on defined task families, with and without its knowledge grounding.

name: OWL reasoning
label: OWL reasoning
summary: Materializes inferences with a reasoner before any AI consumes the context.

name: Polanyi's tacit/explicit distinction
label: Polanyi's tacit/explicit distinction
summary: Classifies each knowledge item by whether its holder can articulate it (we know more than we can tell).
elicitation_tradeoff: Gives up nuance for tractability: a binary label on what is really a spectrum.

name: Structured practitioner interview
label: Structured practitioner interview
summary: A structured interview that asks why choices are made and what happens when the procedure is not enough.
elicitation_tradeoff: Gives up accuracy for practicality: an hour of talk, but practitioners describe what they believe they do.

name: Process-domain embedding model selection and tuning
label: Process-domain embedding model selection and tuning
summary: Chooses or tunes the embedding model so that retrieval similarity reflects process-domain meaning.

name: Process knowledge test
label: Process knowledge test
summary: Tests practitioners on a procedure to find competency gaps.

name: Process mapping
label: Process mapping
summary: Draws a process's steps, hand-offs and decisions as participants describe them, before any analysis of waste.

name: Process mining
label: Process mining
summary: Reconstructs actual process flows, deviations and bottlenecks from system event logs.

name: Repertory grid
label: Repertory grid
summary: Compares situations pairwise to reveal the dimensions along which experts discriminate.

name: Retrospective protocol
label: Retrospective protocol
summary: The practitioner explains reasoning after the task, avoiding interference with the work.
elicitation_tradeoff: Gives up some accuracy for undisturbed practice: reasons are reconstructed after the fact.

name: SECI knowledge conversion
label: SECI knowledge conversion
summary: Socialization, externalization, combination and internalization of knowledge.

name: Semantic versioning
label: Semantic versioning
summary: Major, minor and patch releases that state compatibility.

name: Shadowing and observation
label: Shadowing and observation
summary: A knowledge engineer observes a practitioner doing the real work and asks about choices in the moment.
elicitation_tradeoff: Gives up reach for depth and accuracy: one practitioner per shift, seen doing the real work.

name: Social network analysis
label: Social network analysis
summary: Maps who consults whom to find knowledge brokers and concentration risk.

name: Think-aloud protocol
label: Think-aloud protocol
summary: The practitioner verbalizes reasoning while performing the task.
elicitation_tradeoff: Gives up practicality and some accuracy for depth: speaking while working slows and alters the work.

name: Process mapping and value stream analysis
label: Process mapping and value stream analysis
summary: Maps a process end to end to expose hand-offs, waiting and bottlenecks.
